tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// sbyin sreg bzhugs// ༄༅// lha mo 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga rje btsun ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las dge ba'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro ba bde la legs 'god pa// 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sbyin sreg cho ga bshad// lha mo 'od zer can gyi bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ nad dang sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i don du/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs dben par/ thab khung dkar po/ rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed/ kha khyer sor bzhi bkyed nas/ sor bzhi'i 'phangs su brtsigs pa'i mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la mya ngan med pa'i shing bri bar bya'o// der dri zhim zhing kha dog dkar po'i bud shing brtsigs pa'i g.yas su/ yam shing*/ mar/ til/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūr ba/ ku sha rnams rim pa bzhin dgod pa ni/ bsreg rdzas dang*/ g.yon du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dkar gtor gnyis bsham mo// de nas rang nyid shar du phyogs te 'dug pa'i mdun du/ rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang*/ oṃ badzra a mri ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs pas bsngags pa'i dri'i chu bzhag go /sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o// de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ bdag nyid la mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ thab dang bsreg rdzas/ mchod rdzas rnams la dri'i chus gtor zhing*/ a mri tas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shuddho3 ham̐/ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che dkar po las grub pa'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan par bud shing gi rtsig pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par bskyed nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/

mchod rdzas dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i mes/ bud shing la lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ agna yai dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod nas spar ba/ dri'i chu dang a mṛ tas bsang zhing*/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa zhu ba las/ me lha dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ ra skyes dmar po la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa dbyu gu gsum pa/ g.yon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ khri snyan sa le'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang*/ mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ zhi zhing dul ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar bskyed pa'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas/ rang gi snying ga'i mam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs bar bsam zhing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ dbyug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya las g.yab pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha drang srong 'byung po'i bdag /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi zhes pas spyan drangs la thab kyi shar lhor bzhugs pa la/ oṃ agna ye padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis padma'i gdan phul nas/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes kun la sbyar la/ oṃ argham̐ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyam̐ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ dī pe āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ shapda āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo phul nas/

me lha'i lce'i rtse mor rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba dgang blugs kyi ram̐ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ agna ye dī pyā dī pyā bi shuddha ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul lo// de nas rang gi snying ga nas/ lcags kyu zhags pa/ lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas/ me lha dam tshig pa la bstim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e hye hi agna ye sa pa ri wā ra badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥbadzra pā sha hūm̐/ badzra spho ṭa bam̐/ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥzhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang*/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas de nyid mchod pa dang*/ gnas bsrung ba'i don du ku sha rnams/ oṃ agna ye bdag cag la gegs med par mdzod cig las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad nas dbul lo// mchod yon la sogs pas mchod pa rnams gong du brjod pa'i tshul gyis phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras// me lha'i rgyal po khro bos dbang bskur zhing*// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod do// de nas bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ agna ye/ bdag cag gi sdig pa dang*/

sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes thog ma dang tha mar spel tshig dang bcas pa dang*/ bar du spel tshig med par grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam re dbul te/ go rim ni bshams pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro// slar yang sngar ltar mchod cing bstod la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod nas/ mar gyi blugs gzar gcig blugs pas me lha 'bar ba'i mer gyur par blta'o// 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// //de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su rje btsun ma 'od zer can bdag bskyed ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ 'od zer can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hye hi mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi satwa sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod nas spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ mā rī tsyai arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod cing bstod nas/ me lha'i skabs ltar lha mo bzhis dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ sgrub thabs ltar dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs pa la/ snga ma ltar byon zan dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ mā rī tsyai agna ye swā hā zhes bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byon zan dbul lo// de nas oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi satwā ya zhes kun la sbyar la arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar phyi'i mchod pas mchod la/

bstod pa rnams kyis bstod nas/ bsreg rdzas so sor phul bas yam shing gis gzi brjid dang*/ mar gyis tshe 'phel zhing til gyis nad dang bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang*/ zas mchog gis phun sum tshogs pa 'phel ba dang*/ 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru rnams kyis longs spyod dang dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang*/ dūr bas tshe 'phel ba dang*/ ku shas bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub gnang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ mā rī tsyai bdag cag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes thog ma dang tha mar spel tshig dang bcas pa dang*/ bar du spel tshig med pa'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa gcig la sogs pa dbul lo// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rdzas kyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ til la bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis stong la sogs pa dbul lo// gal te sbod gtong dang*/ byad stems la sogs pa yod kyis dogs na/ tadya thā/ oṃ ba ta li nas mo ha ya'i bar brjod pa'i mthar/ pha rol gyi sbod gtong dang*/ byad stems thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes brjod cing*/ brgya'am stong la sogs pa ci rigs pa dbul lo// bar skabs su me gso ba'i phyir/ bud shing bsnan zhing*/ yam shing dang mar yang ci rigs su dbul lo// de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams phul ba rdzogs pa'i mthar yang snying spel tshig dang bcas pa'i dgang blugs gsum byon zan gyi skabs ltar dbul lo// de nas mchod cing bstod la/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar gsol ba btab pa ltar gnang bar bsam mo// de nas ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badzra muḥzhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ thal ba cung zad rang gi dpral ba/ mgrin pa snying gar bskus nas/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ste dngos gzhi'o// de nas thab tu mar dgang gzar gang blugs nas/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su me lha sngar bzhin gsal bar dmigs la mchod cing bstod do// bsreg rdzas rnams bdun bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa re re sngar ltar phul la/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ agna ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya/ gṛhṇā pa ya/ ma ma sarba pā paṃ sarba bighnān/ sarba u pa dra bya shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la slar yang mchod cing bstod de/ 'das pa'i skabs ltar 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab nas/ bzod par gsol la spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las phyir bkyed de/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod// slar yang dus bzhin ci nas byon// bdag gi las rnams thams cad sgrubs// oṃ agna ye badzra muḥzhes brjod pas rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// de nas las kyi rjes bsdus te/ thal ba rol mo dang bcas pas chu bo chen por dor la/

dga' ston la longs spyod cing*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod pa dang*/ smon lam rgya chen po gdab bo// gal te gzhan gyi don du byed par 'dod na/ bsgrub bya de nyid la dmigs shing*/ ming dang spel te bsreg blugs phul bas de'i don du 'gyur ba nyid do// sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim// tshim nas dngos grub rab tu ster// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni dgang*// zhes 'byung bas/ sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa dang*/ byang chub bsgrub pa dang*/ thun mong gi las bsgrub pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa 'di sbyar ba'o// de ltar 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg gi /cho ga bshad pa'i dge ba'i me 'od kyis// srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus rnam bsregs nas// kun mkhyen ye shes snang ba 'bar bar shog /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg 'di ni/ rang gi slob ma lo tsā ba sam̐ gha zhes bya bas bskul ba'i don du/ 'phags pas sa mo yos bu'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu gsum la chu mig dpal gyi sde chen du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' dpal lo// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
